title: Evidence ingestion resume state
description: Durable progress of one ingestion, written atomically (temporary file plus rename) before the first request and after every acknowledgment, so a lost response or crash resumes without rerunning tests. Holds paths and IDs only; never a token or report bytes. `just evidence-resume STATE` takes endpoint, repository, and token path from it.

endpoint.description: Service origin, without the `/v1` prefix (as in ingest-config).

token_file.description: Native path of the producer token file; the token itself is never stored.

input.description: The original bundle, copied byte for byte beside the state (`<state>.input.json`) so the source may be deleted. A resume verifies `sha256` before sending anything.

file.description: Native path of the retained copy.

source.description: Native path the input was read from, as provenance.

submission.description: The adapted collection exactly as submitted (canonical bytes), retained beside the state as `<state>.collection.json`. Its SHA-256 is `collection_id`, which a resume verifies before sending anything.

state.description: Once `acknowledged`, the collection is never resubmitted.

uploads.description: Every reference mapped from `--proof-dir`: each report, plus each proof's expected listing and completion record. Identical references appear once; empty without `--proof-dir`.

reference_digest.description: A report's `sha256` or the proof digest; a file is mapped only when its SHA-256 equals it.

path.description: Original reference path (a proof's `{package}-{gate}.expected.json` or `.completion.json` name), as provenance.

file.description: Native local path of the bytes.

upload_id.description: Present once the upload is opened.

parts_acknowledged.description: A resume restarts from the service's `parts_received`.

state.description: `staged`: every part acknowledged, awaiting verifier finalization.
